name: Shinva Medical Instrument Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shinva Medical Instrument Co.,Ltd. provides medical devices, pharmaceutical equipment, medical services, and medical trade in the People's Republic of China. It operates in four segments: Medical Device Products, Medical Trade Products, Pharmaceutical Equipment Products, and Medical Services.
